[E]If you were not [G#]my mom I’d

[E]Regardless, when [G#]you are, the
[A]smell makes me go [E]“dam
[E]My mama [G#]just cooked some of her
[A]sweet ol’ fruity [E]jam"

[Chorus]
[E][F#m]Apricot love
[E][F#m]Marmalade love
[E][F#m]Apricot love
[F#m]My mama made love, such an
[B7]easy thing to do

[Verse 2]
[E]If you were not [G#]my dad Could
[A]I please still be your [E]son
[E]You’re awful [G#]with phones But no one’s
[A]funnier then my [E]old man
[E]“Pick up [G#]the can son and
[A]pull out [E]the beans,
[E]Toss ‘em in [G#]the microwave and
[A]get your big old load [E]of proteins”

[Chorus]
[E][F#m]Protein love
[E][F#m]Microwave love
[E][F#m]Protein Love
[F#m]My daddy made love, yes he in-
[B7]vented love

[E]

[E]If you were not [G#]my folks I would
[A]still have your mother [E]tongue
[E]I’d still get [G#]your jokes, Even
[A]if it’s the [E]cheasiest pun
[G#][E]Okay now, it’s
[A]time to [E]live alone
[E]I know what [G#]I’ll give my family when I’ll
